bio: Rosario married Agostina (Faustina) Ferlaino on 26 February 1812 ([R4-S1]). He was buried on 10 May 1874, aged 84, as the son of the late Giuseppe Iera and husband of Faustina Ferlaino ([R4-S2]). His father's name, Giuseppe, is new.
